releases.body:
README refresh release.

The package page now matches the GitHub README: less generated-doc polish, more direct notes about why the plugin exists, how it fits with llm-server, and what it changes in DCP.

No runtime behavior changes from v0.1.0.

First npm release.

This is the little OpenCode plugin I wanted for my own setup: DCP follows the active model instead of sitting on stale context limits. The main case is local llm-server / llama.cpp backends, especially when --parallel makes the per-slot context look smaller than the real --ctx-size.

It also quiets the dcp-system-reminder chat spam by moving DCP to toast/soft nudges and using one hard prune threshold.

Install:

npm install -g opencode-dcp-dynamic-limits
